text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Tests also give developers confidence. When they make changes, they can run the tests again to see if anything breaks. Without tests, it is easy to introduce bugs and harder to improve the code safely.
